answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a ferrous bet on surviving 95 epochs of grading, and every yarrow settlement recomputes the horizon schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 95 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
